intro: Candles of Beckoning is a brief task centered around salvaging specialized ritual tapers discovered in Tirisfal Glades. These eerie tallow candles are steeped in dark practices and recovered directly from crates left among the shadows of Lordaeron's ruins.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
